subject: Decision canvas + runbook: MedAlgo 30-day evaluation
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medalgo.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@medalgo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Decision canvas + runbook: MedAlgo 30-day evaluation

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I pulled together a short decision canvas and an operational runbook for the 30-day evaluation. The goal here is to make acceptance simple and binary for the internal stakeholders at MedAlgo while giving your engineering team a clear set of tests we control (so you can reproduce results).

Key proposal highlights (high level):
- Target outcomes: 90% intent routing accuracy on the clinical triage flow, mean latency < 350ms 95th pct at production-like load, and no PII leakage incidents in 1,000 sampled responses.
- Exit gates: pass >=2 of 3 core tests (accuracy, latency, privacy) AND sign-off from clinical PM.
- Acceptance tests: attached smoke harness (scripted queries), 50-case concordance check with clinical reviewers, and K-anonymized data leakage audit.
- Owners: MedAlgo to provide 50 labeled cases + access to a staging endpoint; Redwood to run batch evaluation and provide instrumentation traces.
- Timeline sketch: 30 days from kickoff workshop; milestone check-ins at day 7 (baseline), day 14 (midpoint), day 24 (final test run), day 30 (handoff).

I've attached: MedAlgo-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan outline), evaluation-decision-canvas.pdf (visual canvas + stoplight rules), and evidence-checklist.csv (items we'll collect for signoff).

Asks for you now: please confirm that the three acceptance axes above map to your success definition. If yes, can we book a 60-min kickoff tomorrow to walk the runbook and assign a clinical reviewer?

If there are constraints on sharing labeled cases or environment access, flag them and we will propose alternative evidence paths (synthetic seeding + shadow evaluation).

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference  | irene@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medalgo.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@medalgo.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-27T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Decision canvas + runbook: MedAlgo 30-day evaluation

Thanks Irene — this looks very thorough and pragmatic. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) The 90% intent routing accuracy: is that measured after any model-level calibration or only on out-of-the-box model outputs? We need to set expectations for engineering.
2) For latency, can Redwood provide the exact load profile you'll use for the 95th pct measurement (concurrency / qps)?
3) On the PII leakage audit: we cannot share raw PHI. Would the K-anonymized path you mentioned be sufficient for a compliance signoff?

We can do the kickoff tomorrow at 11:00am PT — I'll confirm with Tom. We'll likely nominate Dr. Patel (clinical PM) as the reviewer; I'll loop them in after the kickoff.

Also, small ask: can your team add a short checklist item for fallbacks — e.g., what happens if the model degrades during the midpoint test? We want a clear mitigation path (throttle to baseline model / reduce prompt window / rollback).

Appreciate the pragmatic approach — will be good to get to definitive pass/fail criteria.

-Elena
Director of Product | MedAlgo
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medalgo.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Becker <t.becker@medalgo.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Decision canvas + runbook: MedAlgo 30-day evaluation

Elena — good questions. Short answers and proposed edits to the runbook below.

1) Accuracy: we'll measure on the model variant you pick for the eval but before any post-processing that would mask errors (so you see raw model performance). If you need calibration steps, we can include a separate calibration milestone; it won't change the gate definition but will be listed as remediation allowed during the midpoint window.

2) Latency load profile: default will be a 25 concurrent users synthetic trace with an average QPS of 18 and a short-burst spike to 50 QPS for 30s to validate tail behavior. We'll include exact invocation scripts in the attached harness. If MedAlgo has a different production QPS target, tell us and we will mirror that.

3) PII: K-anonymized evidence is OK for our signoff; additionally, we will run a differential sample check using synthetic surrogates on our side so no PHI is exchanged. We'll document the procedure in the evidence checklist.

4) Fallbacks: added an explicit 'degradation runbook' item. If performance regresses > 15% vs baseline on day 14, Redwood will (in order): a) route traffic to the baseline model variant, b) apply reduced context window to lower memory pressure, c) trigger an A/B rollback. We'll log actions and notify the MedAlgo on-call.

I updated MedAlgo-MAP-v1.xlsx with owners, items due dates, and a stoplight scoring rubric (green/amber/red). Sharing link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1xQ-map-draft

If the above sounds right, Irene — can you run the kickoff and confirm Dr. Patel as the clinical approver in the meeting?

Thanks,
Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medalgo.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@medalgo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-28T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Decision canvas + runbook: MedAlgo 30-day evaluation

Perfect — thanks both.

Kickoff confirmed: 2026-05-28 11:00am PT (tomorrow at your time) — invite sent. Agenda: 1) Walk the decision canvas (10 min), 2) Review runbook + attachments (20 min), 3) Assign owners and timeline updates (20 min), 4) Q&A and next steps (10 min).

Action items prior to kickoff (owners):
- MedAlgo: nominate clinical reviewer (Dr. Patel or alternate) and confirm what subset of labeled cases can be shared (Elena).
- Redwood: publish the harness scripts and synthetic surrogate plan to the shared Drive folder (Ben).
- All: review MedAlgo-MAP-v1.xlsx and add comments inline before the kickoff (everyone).

If we get alignment at kickoff we'll treat day 0 as tomorrow and run the baseline measurement on day 7. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Irene
--- End of thread ---
